verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers only the Microsoft Graph mail API: search, drafting and sending, and a developer-facing "Synchronize messages" endpoint. These are developer building blocks for online access, not an offline mode in the Outlook client. No cited item documents reading, searching, or composing email while disconnected, or queuing changes to sync on reconnect, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
